his_words: a hook to check for this session to not run DE until you've fixed this into our quest workflow
why: On a patch ticket, route A (alter to MWP) was recommended without checking it against each Expected line; it adds 3 tugasan per ID where Expected 2 says Tamatkan tugasan.
fix: Quest SKILL.md step 6c gains an EXPECTED-COVERAGE table: before any route on a patch or alter ticket is recommended, each route is checked against every Expected line verbatim; a route that adds tugasan or user steps where the ask is to end them fails; only a route covering every line is recommended.
